scope: Research a low-cost, optional DXF structural differential and distinguish it from byte-level tests, recovery, and document audit costs.

method.kind: Read-only review of current ezdxf official documentation and existing local plan/test policy
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing strict-vs-recovery policy, byte/sentinel tests, optional DXF peer checkpoint, and fast per-slice validation rules
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing fixture and external-J evidence boundaries
method.limitations: Documentation establishes the advertised API and intended behavior, not runtime correctness or performance on this checkout. No exact ezdxf package artifact was pinned or executed; JSON tags were assessed as decoded tag-sequence output, not exact wire bytes.

routeFindings.observed: The documented compact=false representation is an ordered list of group-code/value pairs with string values and one pair per DXF tag.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Optional decoded-tag-sequence comparator only; it does not preserve original text spellings, binary widths, exact record bytes, DWG structure, or ACIS semantics.
routeFindings.planUse: At an existing composed DXF peer checkpoint, strict-read a scratch-generated output and export verbose tags only to diagnose a specific tag ordering/value mismatch. Keep literal byte, binary-width, raw-payload, and following-record checks local.

routeFindings.observed: The API documents repair of fixable errors, reporting of unresolved errors, and audit as potentially long-running. Ordinary strict read and recovery are separate paths.
routeFindings.evidenceCeiling: Diagnostic/repair observation; recovery or a zero-error audit does not prove unchanged round-trip semantics or complete support.
routeFindings.planUse: Keep audit/recovery out of per-slice validation. If useful at the composed checkpoint, record strict result, recovery result, repairs/errors, changed identities/fields, and post-save reopen separately.

ownersRefined: optional ezdxf decoded-tag differential for a specific DXF ordering/value ambiguity
separation of strict parse, recovery, audit repair, and unchanged semantic output
preservation of local byte/sentinel tests as the fast implementation gate
